strings: When most kittens are learning to talk, m_c seems delayed. r_c0 is called, and {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/report/reports} that while m_c will live life just fine, it appears {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} never been able to hear.
m_c isn't bothered by being deaf, though the Clan seems to want to comfort {PRONOUN/m_c/object} when everyone finds out that's why learning to talk has been so hard.
